confidence: Med — address form, POS/arkë/KDS/menu/take away vocabulary and the legal button wording are confirmed on Albanian sources (easybar.al, the consolidated law text, Wolt AL); “food truck” is used as an English loan in Albania but no Albanian food-truck ordering vendor or Albanian-language SERP surfaced; “marrje” (pickup) rests on one Wolt label; Pay at Hatch, plan names and katering i lëvizshëm are Low. csvRows are what WebSearch (US-indexed, not local Google) returned for the query; no Albanian page ranked.
decisions: Food-truck word: keep the English loan “food truck” (Albanian press and festival names write it in Latin); Albanian inflects loans with a hyphen (food truck-u, food truck-et, food truck-eve). Recommend: uninflected after “për” where it reads naturally (“për food truck”), hyphenated definite forms only where grammar needs them. Needs a native check.

Order button: Ligji 9902/2008 (i ndryshuar), neni 37/2 names the words “porosi me detyrim pagese” — use “Porosi me detyrim pagese” on the final order button (a card button “Paguaj {amount}” is acceptable only where it also makes the payment obligation clear).
Pay at Hatch: recommend “Pagesë në marrje” (feature) / “Paguaj në marrje” (button). TRAP: “pagesë në dorëzim” / “paguaj në dorëzim” is cash on delivery — never use it. Low confidence; native check.
“POS” in Albanian everyday use also means the card terminal (“paguaj me POS”), so “not a POS” is worded “jo sistem arke” (not a till system) rather than “jo POS”. Med confidence.
Currency: Albania prices in lekë (ALL, “500 lekë”), not euro — make sure examples do not show €.
{country} = “Shqipëri” (indefinite) is assumed; strings keep it in brackets or after an em dash so no case ending is needed.
